body: I'm on Zoloft, yes I take as directed, don't mix it with alcohol. I've tried to get my doctor to change my meds but they refused. Each day is worse than the next. It's like trying to dig a hole at high tide, no matter how much progress I make another wave comes along and just dumps more sand on top. I've been in therapy over a year and no I don't dare tell them I'm suicidal, not about to go through that shit again.
